title: 10 Safety Tips for Women Planners Traveling Solo
summary: Planners sometimes become so focused on keeping their attendees safe that they forget to protect themselves when they travel alone.

title: Ohio State Wants More Meetings. It’s Offering More Than Just Space
summary: Plenty of universities rent meeting space. Ohio State is making its campus easier to book while offering something hotels can’t: access to faculty expertise, research facilities, and academic experiences.

title: New Research: Trade Shows Are Delivering Efficiency, but Education Isn’t Pulling Its Weight
summary: Both buyers and sellers view trade shows as a cost-effective way to meet with the most people — but fewer than one in 10 rank education as the main reason to attend.

title: Healthcare Association Files for Bankruptcy, Cancels Conference 8 Days Before Opening
summary: A healthcare association’s bankruptcy filing days before its annual conference leaves attendees, sponsors, and a host hotel with plenty of questions. Now, other event organizers are stepping in to preserve educational programming and offer alternatives.

title: Marriott Wants AI Partners to Deliver New Meetings Business, Not Just Collect Fees
summary: AI is changing how planners find and book meetings. Marriott sees an opportunity to generate new business but wants to ensure emerging technology platforms aren’t simply collecting commissions on bookings that would have happened anyway.

title: The Continuing Merger Between Travel and Meetings
summary: New GBTA data shows travel managers are absorbing meetings work faster than they’re adding people to do it. Planners will need to speak up and make the ROI case to colleagues who may be less attuned to the nuances of program design.

title: Mexico’s New $1.5 Billion Luxury Theme Park Wants Your Incentive Group
summary: A theme park built for exclusivity gives planners a new kind of reward trip to pitch. Whether it survives the  security review is another question.

title: Speakers Bureau Head Shares 5 Things Planners Could Do Better
summary: Planners who treat the speaker as an afterthought, or the bureau as a search engine, are leaving value on the table, according to a bureau founder who’s seen the process from every side.

title: 14 Venues, 3,500 Delegates, One Day to Load In: Inside the B20 Summit
summary: Turning an entire neighborhood into a conference campus offers an alternative to the traditional convention center model, but at what operational cost? The B20 Summit will test whether the flexibility of a decentralized event outweighs the logistical challenges.

title: Why the Most Effective Event Sponsors Aren’t Worried About Having Their Logos On the Wall
summary: Sponsors are trading signage and swag for co-created moments that add to the event experience — and it’s paying off in recognition and repeat business.
